sources.title: 국가유산청 고려사 보물 2114-1 官方韩文指定说明：43印本／46册及补写8、12、26

sources.quality_notes: 13IY exact API title and item identity verified, HTTP 200 6398 bytes SHA256 711ba17ffa8f09f091c04eea1de8a89ee1fd43ad35e8cd81318ccb4e2bfbec80; full Korean description 2149 chars SHA256 6b0f04d2186d9d191438c16630dcca378827241a566249def7e55d208dfbbf8b explicitly says 8/12/26 manuscript replaced in 46 books (139 juan), designated 131/43.
